description: Corning Incorporated traces its origins to a glass business established in 1851, with the present corporation incorporated in the State of New York in December 1936 and renamed from Corning Glass Works to Corning Incorporated on April 28, 1989. It describes itself as vital to progress in the industries it helps advance, and with a 175-year track record of life-changing inventions it applies its expertise in glass science, ceramic science and optical physics, along with deep manufacturing and engineering capabilities, to develop category-defining products that transform industries and enhance people's lives. Its capabilities are versatile and synergistic, and it operates through reportable segments including Optical Communications, which represented 38 percent of total segment net sales in 2025, and Display, which manufactures glass substrates for flat panel displays including liquid crystal displays and organic light-emitting diodes using technology expertise and a proprietary fusion manufacturing process that it invented.
